[!cgo] skip

env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env GOCACHE=$WORK/cache-all

cd m
! logos lint --json-diagnostics ./...
stderr -count=1 '"rule_id":"correctness::typed_nil_return"'
stderr '"file":"[^"]*c/c\.go"'
! stderr '"file":"[^"]*external'

env GOCACHE=$WORK/cache-p
logos lint --json-diagnostics ./p
! stderr '"rule_id":"correctness::typed_nil_return"'

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/cgoscope

go 1.27

require example.com/external v0.0.0
replace example.com/external => ../external

-- m/p/p.go --
package p

import (
	"example.com/cgoscope/c"
	"example.com/external"
)

var Bad = c.Bad
var ExternalBad = external.Bad

-- m/c/c.go --
package c

import "C"

type T struct { N C.int }
func Bad() any { return (*T)(nil) }

-- external/go.mod --
module example.com/external

go 1.27

-- external/external.go --
package external

import "C"

type T struct { N C.int }
func Bad() any { return (*T)(nil) }
